items.description: The 300-scholar quota was counting sync codes as if they were people. Any code the server had not seen before took a seat, and the sync endpoint answers callers who are not signed in, so a few hundred made-up strings were enough to fill the server and turn away real sign-ups until those entries aged out. Only a Scholar Account holds a seat now, and the leftovers are cleared on the next registration.

The username check used to answer "available" whenever it could not reach the database. It now says it could not check, because the sign-up would have failed a moment later for a reason nobody could see.
